summary_1line: Pandavas visit Dhritarashtra’s forest hermitage, observe ascetic life, give gifts to sages, and greet Vyasa who questions the old king about his spiritual progress.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira walks through the forest hermitage where sacred fires burn on altars, smoke of ghee rising as deer graze fearlessly among chanting ascetics.
The Pandavas sit on the bare ground beneath trees near their mother Kunti after eating simple fruits and roots given by Dhritarashtra.
Sage Vyasa arrives with disciples and takes a kusa‑grass seat on a black deer‑skin as the Pandavas and Dhritarashtra rise respectfully before him.
